description: Test file for Kubernetes API server KMS configuration, including encryption provider flags, config file creation, and KMS integration volume mounts.

classes.name: kubeAPIServerEnv
classes.description: Struct holding environment variables for kube-apiserver configuration.

methods.name: TestEncryptionProviderFlag
methods.description: Tests whether the encryption provider flag is correctly included in the kube-apiserver command based on environment variable.

methods.name: TestEncryptionProviderConfig
methods.description: Verifies that the encryption provider configuration file is created with the expected content.

methods.name: TestKMSIntegration
methods.description: Checks that the KMS volume and volume mount are correctly configured based on the Cloud KMS integration setting.
